important_rules: Azula 1UBR Firebending2 attack trigger produces RR that persists through combat, not through second main phase.
Azula copies any spell CAST while she is attacking, including permanent spells with real legal combat flash timing; copies are not cast and do not recursively trigger Azula.
Copies of Big Score use the already paid original discard additional-cost choice, not a second discard; each copy yields independent draw2 plus two Treasures.
Storm-Kiln Artist magecraft triggers once for cast and once for Azula's COPY of an instant/sorcery; not for copying a permanent spell.
A spell cast after Azula is removed from combat will not be copied; spells already triggered may still produce copy after removal.
Normal sorcery/creature cast timing applies during combat absent High Fae Trickster, Borne Upon a Wind, Quicken, or Emergence Zone.
Breach escape needs proper graveyard resources and other combo routes are not proof of Azula combat engine success.
